question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No.1.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e. **'With'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most **appropriate option **to fill in blank No.1 is 2) **"with".**
 
• In the given context, the preposition **"with"** is the correct choice because it shows that the dolphins are using one of their brain hemispheres to sleep.
 
• **"With"** in this context signifies possession or means.
 
• The dolphins possess two brain hemispheres and they use one to sleep. So, **"with"** **fits perfectly** in the sentence.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* Generally, dolphins sleep **with **only one brain hemisphere in slow-wave sleep at a time, thus (2) ______ enough consciousness to breathe and to watch for possible (3) ______ and other threats. Early (4) ______ stages can occur simultaneously in both hemispheres. In captivity, dolphins seemingly enter a fully asleep state where both eyes are closed and there is no response to mild external (5) ______.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explain why the other options are incorrect:
 
• **"On" - **This preposition is used to express a state of being in contact with or supported by something. It doesn't fit in this context.
 
• **"Over" - **This preposition typically indicates movement from one place to another, above the place mentioned, or covering a particular area. It doesn't fit in this context.
 
• **"Through" - **This preposition generally signifies movement from one end or side to another. It doesn't fit in this context.
